title: An agent session cannot write _tools/tests_ceiling.json or a decision row of _decisions.csv directly
goal: a direct Edit or Write of _tools/tests_ceiling.json or kb/_self/_decisions.csv from an agent session is refused (deny rules in .claude/settings.json or a PreToolUse hook, the operator's choice through a gate before any change to settings), so the ceiling changes only by the operator's recorded ceiling-class answer and not by an edited file plus a hand-written active operator row that tests.py read_ceiling accepts

run: import json,sys;s=json.load(open('.claude/settings.json'));d=' '.join(s.get('permissions',{}).get('deny',[]));sys.exit(0 if 'tests_ceiling.json' in d and '_decisions.csv' in d else 1)
